items.q: How should every paycheck be split like the 1%?
items.a: **25% growth** (assets that compound), **15% stability** (emergency reserve), **50% essentials** (true needs only), **10% rewards** (guilt-free joy). Wealth comes from **owning** assets/skills/businesses — not salary alone.

items.q: What ownership mix does Mark cite among the richest?
items.a: Richest people are **75% entrepreneurs**, **15% investors**, and **0% pure salary employees**. *"If you don't own something, you are what's owned."*

items.q: Does starting early beat saving more later?
items.a: Yes. Billy's **$200/mo from age 20** beats Phil's **$300/mo from age 30** at ~**10%** S&P returns (**$1.26M vs $678K**). Billy invested **$12K less** but finished nearly **$600K ahead**.

items.q: What practical system belongs inside the growth 25%?
items.a: Climb the **risk scale** starting with **index funds**, use **tax-advantaged accounts** (ISA, Roth IRA, 401(k) match), then **automate payday** into a **three-fund portfolio** (US + international + bonds). Consistency beats stock-picking.

items.q: How big should the stability fund be, and where does it live?
items.a: Target **5× monthly baseline** (rent, groceries, utilities, transport, work internet). Example: **$1,500/mo → $7,500**. Keep it **accessible in 24h**, **zero risk** (never stocks/crypto), earning **4–5%** in high-yield savings.
One emergency (Mark's **VW Golf engine** story) forces **selling growth assets at a loss** or debt spirals. *"Most people don't have a money problem. They have a **stability problem**."*

items.q: Why can six-figure earners still feel broke?
items.a: Over **60% of Americans earning $100K+** live paycheck to paycheck — **lifestyle creep**, not income. Cap essentials at **50%** to kill fake needs (takeout, forgotten subscriptions, unused gym).

items.q: What purchase filter keeps essentials honest?
items.a: **Impulse?** → 7-day rule. **Brand vs value?** → cost-per-wear. **Improves life?** → buy intentionally. Shrink **housing** and **transport** first (used cars ≤ half of essentials).

items.q: Why budget joy instead of grinding 100% austere?
items.a: **92% overspend** after saving sprints without joy. Auto-deposit **10%** into a separate jar; when it's empty, wait — no raiding other buckets. Prioritize **experiences** over stuff so discipline stays sustainable.
